verdict.rationale: Weave provides an Evaluation object with scoring functions, built-in LLM judge scorers (hallucination, summarization quality) and explicit support for custom scorers, plus dedicated LLM-judge-based evaluation for agent turns via EvaluationLogger — directly matching the story of configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
